ma.env.USER_DATA_PATH

A constant string that represents the directory path that the user can operate(Minimum version: 23.6.0).

The path indicated by ma.env.USER_DATA_PATH is not the actual path for storing files in the system. Instead, it is the virtual path provided by the SDK. The path is converted into a real path in different systems. In the simulator, the virtual path constant is 'h t t p ://usr', and the constant value returned on the Android and iOS devices is mafile://usr. File operations can be performed only in this path.

Sample Code

Function showDataPath() {
  console.log(ma.env.USER_DATA_PATH);
}
